title: cfgaudit findings (--format json)
description: The output of `cfgaudit --format json`: an array of findings. The field names and the shape are stable from v1.20.0 on (#1078); a field may be added in a minor release, and a rename or removal happens only in a major release, announced in the release notes. See https://github.com/cfgaudit/cfgaudit/blob/main/docs/usage.md#json-output

RuleID.description: The rule that reported the finding.

Scope.description: Which settings file the finding comes from, when that matters for its reach: the project's committed file, the project's local override, or the user's global file. Omitted for findings that are not about a settings scope.

File.description: The file the finding is in, as cfgaudit reached it: the scanned directory as given on the command line joined with the path inside it, or the path of a --user, --config or --plugins input. It is not made relative to the scanned directory.

Line.description: 1-based line of the finding, or 0 when the finding is about the file as a whole or the line is not known.

Message.description: What was found and how to fix it. Secrets in it are redacted. The wording is not stable: match on RuleID, not on the message.

OWASP.description: The OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications id of the rule (LLM01 to LLM10). Every rule has one; it is omitted only if a rule's documentation lacks it.

AVEID.description: The Agentic Vulnerability Enumeration id the rule maps to. Omitted for rules without one.
